question:
Carefully read the given information and answer the answers to the upcoming questions.

Six friends A, B, C, D, E, and F are sitting around a circular table facing the center, sitting in such a way that there is equal space between each of them (not necessarily in this order) .

i) A and D sit opposite to each other.

ii) E, which is second to the right of D, is sitting in the second position from the left of F

iii) B never sits in the opposite direction of E.

Who is sitting from the Second to the left of the person who is sitting at the third position from the right side of A?
solution:
Given : 

 
• Six friends - A, B, C, D, E, and F
 
• All of them are sitting around a circular table facing the center, sitting in such a way that there is an equal space between each of them (not necessarily in this order) .

Explanation : 

1) E, which is sitting second from the right of D, is sitting in the second position from the left of F

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e595b7cb945b7cec6a6653cdc8eb7a9f80930256bc3f80e968fc1160109afc2.png] 

2) A and D are at the same distance from your left and right sides.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17c9fd759ff35516912ff302f71cf290010ca19cd3920752026af56de364cfa0.png] 

3) B is never sitting in front of E.

After positioning B, only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e1a6c494925abf7727c34e01c06555ecc87d16a4ad24a8ffd2593325697a907.png] 

**Thus, according to the final arrangement is D sitting at the third position from the right side of A and therefore F is sitting second from the left side of D. **

Hence, "F" is the correct answer.
